answer: Agreement audits for graders: for every pair of IDs that have sat on 20+ juries together, the ledger compares their match rate to the crowd baseline. Agree 25 points above it, say 95% vs 70%, and their two votes merge into one. Clones running one script agree too perfectly; that excess is the signal, like two drywall crews whose seams line up to the millimetre. Honest graders drift like a zephyr. A farm that adds noise to hide starts a spiral of calls off the jury median. Proposed thresholds, not measured.
